获得 +3 威力。本回合不重获冰霜。

前置，选择一项：瞬移至一个精灵，收回它并获得 +1 威力。后退 1。

开始：瞬移至对手身后最近的空间。

你的速度变为 4。

这6张图是桌游BattleCON的卡牌背面条带（每图含多张卡，卡名为装饰性手写风格字体）。请逐张转录每张卡的标题（卡名），逐字母给出你的最佳判读，不确定的字母用?标注。跳过写有FINISHERS/BASES的参考卡和纯模式卡。例：图1第2张：THEME SONG。全部列完。然后对每张卡用一句话概述其效果文本（英文原文照抄关键句）。

以下是根据提供的图片，跳过写有“FINISHERS”和“BASES”的参考卡与纯模式卡后，对剩余卡牌标题的转录及效果概述：

图1

TAKE FLIGHT：Describe the character's setup and ante effect. ("Limited Ante: Become Flying or Grounded. After changing to Grounded, you have -1 Power during this beat.")

THEME SONG：An attack pair card detailing hit effects. ("Hit: For the rest of the duel, when you become Grounded or Flying Advance or Retreat 0-3.")

图2

RIDE OF A LIFETIME：Explains a unique mechanic using a Motorcycle marker. ("Whenever the Motorcycle leaves your space, Advance or Retreat 0-1 in the same direction it moved.")

THE GETAWAY：An attack pair card with specific start and end phase effects. ("End: Teleport on or adjacent to the Motorcycle. End: +3 Power next beat.")

WISHFUL THINKING：Describes Dajin's Wish card mechanics and Empowered state. ("Dajin has 6 distinct Wish Cards... While he has 3 or more Wishes in play, he becomes Empowered...")

PRICE OF POWER：An attack pair card that interacts with Wishes. ("After: Chip 2 per inactive Wish. Activate all Wishes (flip them to the active side, they are not Granted).")

图3

REGULATION LIMITER：Describes Feylana's Geas Pile and Conviction mechanics. ("Conviction: You have Conviction if the opponent's attack contains copy of a card in your Geas Pile.")

CASE CLOSED：An attack pair card interacting with the Geas Pile. ("Damage: Pick up any number of Bases from the Geas Pile, then put any number of Bases into the Geas Pile.")

MARRIJANI CURSE：Describes John's Stonestkin Tokens setup and ante effect. ("Limited Ante: Use a Stoneskin to give yourself or the Opponent Armor 2 and 'When this fighter would move for the first time this beat, prevent that movement.'")

图4

MARRIJANI CURSE：Reiteration of John's passive and setup rules. ("End, you moved: Regain a Stoneskin.")

BLAST MINING：An attack pair card with Stun Immunity and Ignore Armor. ("Stun Immunity, Ignore Armor")

图5

PUZZLING BOX：Explains Kai's Functions and Perplexed state. ("Perplexed: -1 Priority for each active Function, then deactivate all Functions...")

FINAL SACRIFICE：An attack pair card scaling with active Functions. ("Reveal, 5 Functions Active: +15 Power.")

DESERT'S EMBRACE：Describes Kora's Thorn Counters mechanics. ("Start: Chip 1 per Thorn in your supply. Hit: Regain a Thorn.")

QUEEN OF PAN：An attack pair card featuring Thorn regeneration and damage. ("After: Inflict 2 damage per Thorn depleted this beat.")

FROSTBITE：Describes Rin's Frost Counters and setup. ("End, did not hit the Opponent: Deplete 1 Frost.")

THE DRAGON'S FROZEN CLAW：An attack pair card with Frost conditional effects. ("Reveal, 3+ Frost held: +1 Power and +2 Priority.")

图6

ETERNAL SERVITUDE：Describes Vekyl's Wisp mechanics. ("End: Withdraw a Wisp on an opponent for Chip 1. Starting with the Wisp nearest to the opponent, shift each Wisp 1 towards the opponent...")

TRANSFIX：An attack pair card that scales with Wisps. ("Hit: Push or Pull 0-4. +2 Power per Wisp's space the opponent left during this movement.")

AIR SUPPORT：Describes Wendy's Target Markers mechanics. ("Whenever a Target enters the Opponent's space, the Opponent may Advance or Retreat 1 in the direction the Target moved...")

FIRE AT WILL：An attack pair card using Target mechanics. ("Before: Place Target C on you. Shift each Target 1-2.")
